subject: Validator hardening — Wave 12 gap repair

hardening_items.gap: Previously flagged any non-COMPLETE status as PENDING, including DEFERRED_TO_WAVE13
hardening_items.fix: Added _is_closed_status() helper: COMPLETE or any DEFERRED_TO_* status is a valid closed state
hardening_items.new_behavior: TCC-01 PASSes if all taskcards are COMPLETE or DEFERRED_TO_*; FAILs if any are PENDING or unknown status

hardening_items.gap: Used tc.get('status') != 'COMPLETE' — would fail SPRINT_COMPLETE verdict if any deferred task existed
hardening_items.fix: Updated to use _is_closed_status() — DEFERRED_TO_* allowed when verdict=SPRINT_COMPLETE
hardening_items.new_behavior: SPRINT_COMPLETE verdict is valid if all taskcards are COMPLETE or DEFERRED_TO_*

hardening_items.gap: No recognition of sidecar protocol — would fail for Wave 13+ closeouts that use external .sha256 sidecar
hardening_items.fix: If sidecar_path is in closeout, BMV-01 passes and defers to BMV-06
hardening_items.new_behavior: Legacy mode: checks evidence_bundle.sha256 for 64-char hex; Sidecar mode: passes, BMV-06 verifies

hardening_items.gap: No validator existed for external sidecar proof protocol — introduced Wave 13
hardening_items.fix: Added BMV-06: verifies sidecar file exists and contains valid 64-char lowercase hex SHA-256
hardening_items.new_behavior: If sidecar_path absent: PASS (legacy mode). If present: verifies file exists and content is valid SHA-256

hardening_items.target: Wave 13 IV script (to be written in Lane H)
hardening_items.gap: Wave 12 IV-02 only checked that taskcards.json EXISTS; did not count or validate COMPLETE status
hardening_items.fix: Wave 13 IV will include explicit check: read taskcards.json, count status values, assert 0 PENDING
hardening_items.new_behavior: IV will fail if any current-sprint taskcard has status=PENDING

hardening_items.target: Wave 13 adversarial review (to be written in Lane H)
hardening_items.gap: Wave 12 adversarial review checked policy text but did not read disk state of taskcards.json
hardening_items.fix: Wave 13 adversarial review will read and count taskcard statuses from disk before claiming PASS
hardening_items.new_behavior: Adversarial review will explicitly count PENDING vs COMPLETE vs DEFERRED and report actuals

file_changes: src/plugin_examples/fixture_factory/taskcard_closeout_validators.py — added _is_closed_status(), updated TCC-01/06, updated BMV-01, added BMV-06, updated run_all_bmv_validators
tests/unit/test_taskcard_closeout_validators.py — added 11 new tests covering deferred status + sidecar protocol
